mechanism: Carisoprodol may inhibit phenytoin metabolism via CYP2C19, potentially increasing phenytoin levels and toxicity risk; phenytoin may induce carisoprodol metabolism via CYP3A4, reducing carisoprodol efficacy.
action: Monitor phenytoin serum levels and signs of toxicity (ataxia, nystagmus, confusion); consider phenytoin dosage adjustment and monitor carisoprodol efficacy; assess for increased CNS depression.
